text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, 'Noto Sans SC', sans-serif
text.tspan: Each app is drawn in layers; a layer uses only the layers below it. Both apps are built from the same versioned packages but released on their own. The server side is kept to a few boxes.
